task.title: Reject non-finite plot data
task.description: Strengthen CSV and direct plotting validation so NaN and infinite numeric values are rejected before plotting.
requirements: Reject NaN, positive infinity, and negative infinity in either selected CSV column.
Reject the same non-finite values when create_plot is called directly.
Raise descriptive ValueError messages that identify each affected axis or column once.
Add focused pytest coverage for CSV and direct create_plot non-finite inputs.
Preserve existing missing-column, empty-data, numeric-type, length, CLI, and successful plotting behavior.
Do not change sonar-project.properties, quality-gate rules, analysis scope, or tests merely to suppress a finding.
acceptance_criteria: At least one unconstrained candidate passes the complete pytest suite.
At least one unconstrained candidate passes the MCP-backed SonarQube quality gate.
The constrained candidate is excluded from winner selection.
The join node selects by fewest Sonar findings, then fewest fixes, then candidate ID.
Only the selected candidate's managed fixture files are promoted.

approval.content: Validate selected CSV values and direct create_plot inputs with a small shared helper that rejects NaN and both infinities before plotting. Report affected columns or axes without duplicate names, add focused regression tests, and preserve every existing validation and public interface. Do not weaken tests or SonarQube configuration.

diff --git a/starter_repo/plot_data.py b/starter_repo/plot_data.py
--- a/starter_repo/plot_data.py
+++ b/starter_repo/plot_data.py
@@ -1,11 +1,26 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env python3
 
 import argparse
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from math import isfinite
 from pathlib import Path
 
 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 import pandas as pd
 from pandas.api.types import is_numeric_dtype
 
 
+def _validate_finite_values(
+    named_values: Iterable[tuple[str, Iterable[float]]], error_prefix: str
+) -> None:
+    """Reject non-finite values and report each affected name once."""
+    affected_names: list[str] = []
+    for name, values in named_values:
+        if name not in affected_names and any(not isfinite(value) for value in values):
+            affected_names.append(name)
+
+    if affected_names:
+        raise ValueError(f"{error_prefix}: {', '.join(affected_names)}")
+
+
 def read_csv_data(file_path: Path, x_col: str, y_col: str) -> tuple[list[float], list[float]]:

--- a/tests/test_plot_data.py
+++ b/tests/test_plot_data.py
@@ -111,8 +111,56 @@ def test_missing_column_error_precedes_non_numeric_validation(non_numeric_csv:
     """Test that missing-column validation retains precedence."""

     assert str(exc_info.value) == "CSV is missing required column(s): missing_x"
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "non_finite_value",
+    [float("nan"), float("inf"), float("-inf")],
+    ids=["nan", "positive-infinity", "negative-infinity"],
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("column", ["x", "y"])
+def test_read_csv_data_rejects_non_finite_selected_column(
+    tmp_path: Path, column: str, non_finite_value: float
+) -> None:
+    """Test that every non-finite value is rejected in either selected column."""
+    x_value = non_finite_value if column == "x" else 1.0
+    y_value = non_finite_value if column == "y" else 1.0
+    file_path = tmp_path / f"{column}_non_finite.csv"
+    file_path.write_text(f"x,y\n{x_value},{y_value}\n")
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:

+
+    assert str(exc_info.value) == f"CSV column(s) contain non-finite values: {column}"

+
+def test_read_csv_data_reports_all_non_finite_columns_once(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    """Test that all affected CSV columns are identified once."""

+    file_path.write_text("horizontal,vertical\nnan,inf\n")
+

+    file_path = tmp_path / "shared_non_finite_column.csv"
+    file_path.write_text("value,other\n-inf,1\n")
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:
+        read_csv_data(file_path, "value", "value")
+
+    message = str(exc_info.value)
+    assert message == "CSV column(s) contain non-finite values: value"
+    assert message.count("value") == 1
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+def test_create_plot_reports_all_non_finite_axes_once() -> None:
